# Colour · 色彩

Palette inspiration, tools that build perceptually even and accessible scales, contrast and colour-vision checks, and the articles that explain why. Compute contrast; never estimate it.

41 resources, plus 7 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `scripts/catalog.py find` searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Palette inspiration · 色板灵感

For mood and starting points. A palette is not a system until roles and contrast are defined.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| [Realtime Colors](https://www.realtimecolors.com) | Preview a palette and font pair on a real page layout, then export tokens | The fastest sanity check of a palette in context | A | tool | static | free |  |

## Scale and system builders · 色阶与系统生成

Generate scales in a perceptual space; map steps to roles.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [OKLCH Color Picker](https://oklch.com) | Picker and converter for OKLCH with gamut visualisation (sRGB, P3, Rec2020) | See where a colour leaves the sRGB gamut before building a scale | S | tool | static | free · MIT |  |
| [Radix Colors](https://www.radix-ui.com/colors) | Twelve-step scales where each step has a defined UI purpose, with matched dark and alpha scales | Read Understanding the scale for the step-to-role mapping (1-2 backgrounds, 3-5 component states, 6-8 borders, 9-10 solids, 11-12 text); agents can pull any scale as CSS variables from the npm package | S | system | static | free · MIT | [Understanding the scale (step to role)](https://www.radix-ui.com/colors/docs/palette-composition/understanding-the-scale); API `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@radix-ui/colors@latest/{scale}.css` |
| [Leonardo](https://leonardocolor.io) | Generates colour scales by target contrast ratios, with adaptive themes | Specify contrast targets, get colours; the inverse of picking then checking | S | tool | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [Source and npm package @adobe/leonardo-contrast-colors](https://github.com/adobe/leonardo) |
| [Tailwind CSS colors](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/colors) | Widely used 11-step palette defined in OKLCH | Read the OKLCH lightness and chroma curve across 50-950 as a reference; agents can read every value from theme.css in the npm package | A | system | static | free · MIT | API `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tailwindcss@latest/theme.css` |

| [UI Colors](https://uicolors.app) | Tailwind scale generator with UI previews and contrast grid | Enter a brand hex, add neutral and status scales (success, info, warning, error), preview them on real components and export the Tailwind config | A | tool | static | freemium |  |
| [Accessible Palette](https://accessiblepalette.com) | Creates palettes with consistent lightness and contrast across hues | Ensures step 600 of every hue passes the same contrast | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [Atmos](https://atmos.style) | LCH palette builder with shade curves and contrast checking | A more visual alternative for curve editing | A | tool | static | freemium · login |  |
| [ColorBox](https://colorbox.io) | Lyft's scale generator: shape hue, saturation and brightness per step with easing curves, then export the scale | Use when a scale needs hand-tuned curves rather than a formula; check the result's contrast steps afterwards | A | generator | static | free · Apache-2.0 (algorithm) · slow |  |

## Contrast and colour vision · 对比度与色觉

WCAG 2 ratios are the legal baseline. APCA is an independent proposal, not part of the WCAG 3 drafts, whose contrast method is still undecided. Compute contrast; never estimate it.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ColorBrewer (home: dataviz)](https://colorbrewer2.org) | Research-based sequential, diverging and qualitative schemes for maps and charts | Choose the nature of the data (sequential, diverging, qualitative) and the number of classes, tick 'colorblind safe' and 'print friendly', then export HEX, RGB or a JS array. | S | tool | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/axismaps/colorbrewer) |
| [WebAIM Contrast Checker](https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/) | The standard quick WCAG contrast check, with an API | API: https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/?fcolor=<hex>&bcolor=<hex>&api | S | tool | static | free | API `https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/?fcolor={hex}&bcolor={hex}&api` |
| [Colour Contrast Analyser (CCA) (home: a11y)](https://vispero.com/lp/color-contrast-checker/) | Free desktop contrast checker whose eyedropper samples any pixel on screen: text over photos, gradients, screenshots and design files | Use when the colours are not in code; sample the lightest background pixel behind the text and read the WCAG AA and AAA results. | A | tool | static | free · GPL-3.0 | [Source and releases (GitHub)](https://github.com/ThePacielloGroup/CCAe) |
| [Who Can Use](https://www.whocanuse.com) | Shows how a colour pair performs across vision types | Use to make contrast findings concrete for stakeholders | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [APCA Contrast Calculator](https://apcacontrast.com) | Reference calculator for APCA lightness contrast with font-size lookup | Use for exploratory perceptual contrast with the font-size lookup; report WCAG 2 ratios as the requirement | A | tool | static | free | [Why APCA (documentation)](https://git.apcacontrast.com/documentation/WhyAPCA) |
| [Contrast Grid](https://contrast-grid.directededges.com) | Tests every foreground against every background in a palette | Paste the palette (one colour per line, optionally with token names), screenshot the grid into the design-system docs as the pairing rule | A | tool | static | free |  |
| [Color Oracle](https://colororacle.org) | Free colour-blindness simulator for Windows, Mac and Linux that filters the whole screen in real time, so any app or design file can be checked | Toggle it over the design tool or browser to check that states, charts and status colours survive deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia | A | tool | static | free · slow |  |
| [Chrome DevTools: emulate vision deficiencies](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/rendering/apply-effects#emulate_vision_deficiencies) | Built-in emulation of blurred vision, reduced contrast, protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia on any live page | Rendering tab > Emulate vision deficiencies; agents get the same through CDP Emulation.setEmulatedVisionDeficiency and can screenshot each mode | A | tool | static | free | [CDP Emulation.setEmulatedVisionDeficiency](https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/tot/Emulation/#method-setEmulatedVisionDeficiency) |
| [Viz Palette (home: dataviz)](https://projects.susielu.com/viz-palette) | Tests a data palette in real chart types under colour-vision deficiencies | Paste the categorical palette, then read the colour report: pairs that collide under each colour-vision deficiency and at small sizes are listed; adjust until none remain. | A | tool | js | free |  |
| [Coloring for Colorblindness (home: dataviz)](https://davidmathlogic.com/colorblind/) | Simulates colour-vision deficiencies on a palette and offers known safe categorical palettes (Okabe-Ito, Wong, IBM) | Check a categorical palette here before shipping, or start from one of its safe palettes when the brand allows. | B | tool | js | free |  |

The reasoning behind modern UI colour systems and dark mode.
